title: Shopee Brazil search and product media
description: Provide exactly one product-name query or Shopee Brazil category URL. Results are ranked by visible sold count when available.

searchQuery.title: Product name
searchQuery.description: Search Shopee Brazil by product name. Use this or Category URL, not both.

categoryUrl.title: Category URL

maxItems.title: Maximum products
